name: @oneworks/model-provider-catalog
description: Versioned model provider metadata catalog for One Works

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.js
scripts.test: pnpm -C ../.. exec vitest run --workspace vitest.workspace.ts --project bundler packages/model-provider-catalog/__tests__
